text: ITEM 1 | Whole, smooth, oval almond-shaped nuts, about 2.5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, with a tan-to-medium-brown color that varies slightly from piece to piece. Surface is matte and dry with no oil sheen, and the pieces are firm and hold their shape. About 20 pieces are piled loosely in the center of a white paper plate, with a few overlapping in a small cluster. Nothing is cooked, glazed, or coated. | 27
